Fair, let me drop the jargon. Graphics cards don't mine Bitcoin any more — these little boxes do, and they do one thing: guess numbers. TH/s is just how many guesses a second.

Every ten minutes the network pays 3.125 BTC to whoever guessed right. Your box guesses around the clock. Pointed at a pool you also get a small share of other people's wins.

Make sense so far?
what are you serious

Dead serious. That's genuinely how Bitcoin mining works — a guessing race, every ten minutes, and the winner takes 3.125 BTC.

Big warehouses do most of the guessing, so a $248 box is a long shot on its own. On a pool it stacks small sats steadily instead. Both run at once, and your power is free.
